name: 38399-eagledecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; the draft head runs inside the target's worker process.
architecture: TARGET LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, max_position_embeddings 8192, bf16, 8.03B params; DRAFT is `model_type: eagle` over one decoder layer at hidden 4096, same vocabulary, max_position_embeddings 2048, loaded in the target's dtype.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 10% by completion, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, `configs/data/mtbench-firstturn-80x5.jsonl` -- 400 rows, the 80 MT-Bench first-turn prompts (question_id 81-160, all eight categories) cycled five times, each row carrying `output_tokens_count: 256`. Raw prompt tokens mean 65.7, min 12, p50 38, p90 179, max 349, pre-chat-template; `request_format: default-template` wraps each row as a user message and applies the model's chat template. Greedy: `temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true`. `spec.seed: 38399` fixes the request order and is not a vLLM seed.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant with a draft model answering short open-ended questions at 16 concurrent streams on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 780ba37458362bdc0596c6511e17749d44b145fc. The interpreter and the hardware seal
# are in configs/env.yaml, which is this machine's answer and is not portable.
#
# WHICH MODEL RUNNER RUNS IS NOT AN ENGINE ARGUMENT. This setup is declared on vLLM's V2 model
# runner, selected at this commit by VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 and by nothing in this file; it is
# carried in configs/tuned.yaml under `apply:`.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

# `abhigoyal/EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B-vllm` ships an `lm_head.weight` that this engine era cannot
# load. This is that checkpoint with the redundant head dropped; the tensor was verified
# BIT-IDENTICAL to the target's, so the draft shares the target head and the numerics are
# unchanged.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "${SYSAGENT_DATA}/scratch/eagle-llama3-8b-sharedhead", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "max_model_len": 2048}

# The draft checkpoint's own max_position_embeddings is 2048, so this ceiling is the draft's.
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 1

# Not the default: the engine's default at this commit is on. Off because the request file cycles
# 80 distinct prompts past its own length, so with caching on the later passes prefill out of cache.
enable-prefix-caching: false

dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 64
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
